name: linear-markdown-sync
description: Sync Linear issues down into local markdown files, with screenshots and attachments, one folder per ticket.

commands.title: Linear Markdown Sync: Set Personal API Key
Linear Markdown Sync: Clear API Key

linearMarkdownSync.rootFolder.markdownDescription: Folder that contains one subfolder per Linear ticket (named by identifier, e.g. `eng-730`). Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder; absolute paths are used as-is.

linearMarkdownSync.syncIntervalMinutes.markdownDescription: Automatically run a sync pass on this interval, in minutes. Set to `0` to disable interval syncing (manual command, activation, and new-folder detection still work).

linearMarkdownSync.syncOnStartup.description: Run a sync pass when the extension activates.

linearMarkdownSync.watchForNewFolders.description: Automatically sync a ticket folder when it is created inside the root folder.

linearMarkdownSync.includeComments.description: Append issue comments to issue.md (also downloads images embedded in comments).
